literal_route_assessment.reason: Official implementation requires Python environment plus OpenAI/Azure model endpoint configuration; that literal route has a residual external model/API execution dependency and can depend on paid/finite API quota. Under control revision 26 it remains an unresolved child and cannot prove Phase-1 acceptance.

chat_native_transfer_scope.scope: assignment-strategy textual optimization only; no claim to reproduce PromptWizard benchmark results or full joint example/CoT optimization
chat_native_transfer_scope.repository_role: lightweight state/evidence transport only, never compute

candidate_variants.description: Chat-native mutate/score/critique/synthesize loop without durable stage identity
PW-V0 plus stable stage_id, candidate IDs, evidence-readback score gate and resume-before-reselection
PW-V1 plus compact evidence-derived failure exemplar set co-edited with the assignment strategy; exemplars may summarize only already observed same-scope failures and never invent performance

precommitted_guards.name: pending_resume_first
precommitted_guards.pass_when: a persisted nonterminal stage is resumed by exact stage_id before any fresh candidate selection

precommitted_guards.name: same_scope_scoring
precommitted_guards.pass_when: candidate comparisons use identical assignment scope and evidence set

precommitted_guards.name: durable_score_gate
precommitted_guards.pass_when: only read-back evidence can enter candidate score

precommitted_guards.name: terminal_credit_gate
precommitted_guards.pass_when: credit requires independently sealed terminal same-scope outcome

precommitted_guards.name: duplicate_credit_reject
precommitted_guards.pass_when: one terminal transition can increment credit at most once

precommitted_guards.name: mechanical_failure_nonsemantic
precommitted_guards.pass_when: rate-limit/CAS/transport failures do not become assignment-quality failures

precommitted_guards.name: bounded_progress
precommitted_guards.pass_when: iteration/no-improvement bound exits or switches instead of self-refining forever

precommitted_guards.name: hidden_executor_reject
precommitted_guards.pass_when: Python/API/hosted-model execution is not required by the accepted Chat-native route

precommitted_guards.name: zero_optional_quota
precommitted_guards.pass_when: route remains valid when every optional monthly/trial/paid quota is zero

precommitted_guards.name: zero_incremental_cost
precommitted_guards.pass_when: route requires no incremental monetary spend

precommitted_guards.name: source_order_fidelity
precommitted_guards.pass_when: critique is derived from scored candidate cases and synthesis consumes that critique; order is mutate->score->critique->synthesize

evaluation_rule: Evaluate all three variants against G1-G12 without changing guards. Prefer the highest guard count; ties prefer greater source-mechanism fidelity only if it does not add dependency, quota, cost or scope ambiguity. Persist the selected variant's exact critique as genuine pending strategy state before synthesis. No frontier credit is eligible in this invocation because no terminal cross-invocation outcome can yet exist.
